title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf Wall Mount Solid Brass | Glokzin Teal | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf while keeping the roll protected in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms.

  • Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom

  • Coordinated style: Part of the Waverly Place collection for matching bath accessories
